proposition: In the R. Shaqq-i Qamar Ibn Turka assigns the verifying Sufis of Ibn ʿArabī's school (ahl-i shuhūd) to level five; on Q 54:1 they read the moon as the perfect form (the human being), and its splitting as meaning emerging in full perfection from that form without ratiocination, a route vouchsafed the Seal.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
